_ai: Second opinion from a local Ollama model (no cloud, no cost). Only jobs whose experience band the scraper could not read are screened, and a job is dropped only when the model is confidently NOT fresher-friendly. Set ai_screening=false to skip it.
_experience: Fresher ceiling. A job is kept only when the LOWEST experience it asks for is <= this number, because a 0-year candidate cannot fill a '3-5 yrs' seat. Also pushed into the actors that support it (Naukri), which means fewer senior results are downloaded and you pay less. 2 = strict fresher, 3 = junior, 4 = also show early-career. Preview any change for free with 'python hunt.py --replay'.
_budget: Apify FREE plan gives $5 per billing cycle. Target <= $0.15/day so a daily run survives the month: $4.50 of $5. 'python hunt.py --dry-run' prints the estimate and refuses to run if the remaining credit is lower than the plan.

wellfound._note: $2.79/1k results - the most expensive source. Enable with --only wellfound on a day you have budget left.
